pairs.subject: edge-queue-policy
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 The context loads messages as a one-shot request/response snapshot that the user can refetch with retry, and settings only reads status/health once and displays an orchestrator `queueLength` number; I searched messages/, settings/ and the whole src/components/dashboard tree for backpressure, drop-oldest, WebSocket, EventSource and highWaterMark and found nothing, so no long-lived bounded producer-to-consumer edge exists here for a queue policy to govern.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 A one-shot awaited fetch, not a standing declared edge with a depth.
src/components/dashboard/views/settings/index.tsx:140 This only displays the remote orchestrator's work-queue length. Nothing in this context drops messages, so there are no drops to count.
src/components/dashboard/views/settings/settings-sections/NotificationsCard.tsx:50 A single preview event is emitted on a click. No queued output gets superseded and needs flushing.
